detailed_description:
cool desaturated palette with warm amber accents, 35mm film texture with subtle grain, motivated practical lighting. Late afternoon sun falls hard across the pale grey paving of the plaza and the glass frontage throws one cold sheet of light back into the crowd.

[Shot 1] A medium shot frames the campus square from a high angle, looking down over the plaza, the camera tilting down slowly. <Char 1> stands at the dead centre of the open paving, facing the south wall of people; the four young women at the front of the onlooking student crowd stand in a line one pace behind her — the crowd a group of more than a dozen campus young men and women, distinct faces, not clones: a tall boy in a grey hoodie with a backpack strHis hairstyle follows the reference image. Her right arm lifts from her shoulder and keeps going until the phone clears the top of her head, her wrist locks and holds, and the cold light of the screen throws one bright patch across the faces of the south ring. Her eyes curve into a smile, her mouth lifts at the corners, her chin tilts up. Behind her the flagpole holds the north edge and the glass frontage of the teaching building closes the far side.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.120 the camera cuts to a medium close-up from a slight low angle, straight on, held static. Several members of the onlooking student crowd at the second layer press sideways toward the centre, upper bodies pitched forward, shoulder blades driving forward: each gains half a step inward, one shoulder knocks the shoulder-back of the person ahead, that person sways once, and the ring tightens by a hand's width. They crane their necks, their mouths set tight, their eyes push toward the centre. Layered backs of heads stack across the frame and the raised phone of <Char 1> glints far off above them.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.310 the shot cuts to an extreme close-up from a slight high angle, straight on, the camera pushing in very slowly until the phone screen fills the frame. The screen sits square to the lens and holds still; a thumb swipes up the glass, the page rolls one screen, and it stops on two comment lines set as small grey-on-white chat text beneath a cropped screenshot — the upper line reads 「听说她跟一个五十多岁的老男人不清不楚」and the lower reads 「她转学手续是怎么办的？」— the text count holding steady while the screen light whitens half a shade. The edge of a finger and the blurred crowd sit at the margins.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.170 the camera cuts to a medium close-up from a slight high angle, from the side, held static. One pace behind <Char 1>, the four young women at the front of the onlooking student crowd stand shoulder to shoulder facing the centre: their forearms cross over their chests and tighten, the forearms rise half an inch, four shoulder lines hold level, four faces lift at the same angle, and four chins stay raised and fixed. Their mouths hold a smile, their eyelids sit half lowered, their chins stay up. <Char 1>'s back, the pale paving and the far wall of people sit behind them; the sun rakes in from frame left.

[Shot 5] At 00:06.110 the camera cuts to a medium close-up at eye level, from the side, tracking slowly. <Char 2> comes off the teaching-building entrance on the east side with her schoolbag on one shoulder, walking west toward the crowd: her front foot drives into the ground, she carries one stride forward, the sole lands and stops dead, her body tips forward and steadies, and the foot she has lifted drops back down to the place it left. Her eyes lock on the crowd, her lips press into one line, the skin between her brows draws tight. The glass doors of the teaching building, a notice board and the far ring of people sit behind her; the afternoon light comes flat across her face.

[Shot 6] At 00:07.810 the camera cuts to an extreme close-up at eye level, straight on, pushing in very slowly onto the side pocket of a canvas schoolbag. The cloth at the pocket mouth stretches open, one corner of a yellowed photograph pushes out, the paper edge sways once as the body above it comes to a stop, and the corner then holds still with the small figure of a child and the hand of an adult just readable on its surface. The weave of the bag and the blurred paving fill the rest of the frame; light falls cool across the cloth.

[Shot 7] At 00:09.170 the camera cuts to a close-up from a slight low angle, straight on, held static. <Char 2> (S2) stands at the outer edge of the ring on the east side, facing the crowd, the schoolbag still on her shoulder. She holds her place: her chest rises once and her gaze sweeps halfway across the ring. Her brows draw together, her jaw sets tight, her eyes stay sharp. Layered backs of heads and the raised phone of <Char 1> sit behind her; hard afternoon light cuts across one cheek. <Char 2> (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover in a low, dry, slightly husky young female voice, with a dry, matter-of-fact tone, at a quickened pace: <d>[Chinese] 我爸的事还没查明白，她先被挂墙上了。</d> while her lips remain completely closed. The frame holds steady to the end — a straight same-scene cut into the next segment, with no shift in position, height, speed or light.

overall_soundscape: The plaza hums a layer thicker than a normal afternoon — dozens of conversations running at once, sneakers scuffing the paving, a bag zip, the distant slam of a teaching-building door — and under it the dry rustle of a crowd shifting its weight.

non_diegetic_music: A dry percussion layer — muted kick and stick clicks — under sparse low piano notes, tight slow tempo, no crescendo, stopping abruptly.
